children: Paychex reported first-quarter results for the period ended Aug. 31, 2026, with revenue of $1.63B and diluted EPS of $1.21, reflecting year‑over‑year growth in both top-line and earnings versus the prior-year quarter.
Revenue was $1.631B for the three months ended Aug 31, 2026, up from $1.540B in the year-ago quarter (6% YoY).
Net income was $429.7M for the three months ended Aug 31, 2026, versus $383.8M in the year-ago quarter (12% YoY).
Diluted EPS was $1.21 for the three months ended Aug 31, 2026, up from $1.06 in the year-ago quarter (14% YoY).
Total revenue rose 6% YoY to $1.63B, driven by 4% growth in Management Solutions and 12% growth in PEO & Insurance.
Higher revenue per client reflected price realization and increased product penetration across SaaS HCM platforms.
PEO momentum was supported by growth in average worksite employees and increased PEO insurance volumes.
The company continued strategic investment in AI-driven technology, platform enhancements, and client-facing software development.
Operating income increased 14% and adjusted operating margin expanded, reflecting disciplined cost management and targeted sales and technology investments.
